barebones.name: Barebones
barebones.description: Minimal Alpine i386 and BusyBox shell.

essentials.name: Essentials
essentials.description: Barebones plus networking, browser transport, curl, jq and QuickJS.

ai-tools.name: AI Tools
ai-tools.description: Essentials plus terminal tools, coding agents, browser tools and AI frameworks.

dev.name: Dev
dev.description: AI Tools plus native esbuild, the browsercode-style Dev IDE (framework picker, Monaco editor, live preview) and the Chi-backed app supervisor with seven ready-to-run project templates.

performance.name: Performance testing
performance.description: AI Tools plus Grafana k6 and k6obs OpenObserve streaming.

vapt.name: VAPT — native scanner
vapt.description: AI Tools plus Grafana k6 and Vaptr, the self-contained native scanner. k6obs and external tools (httpx/katana/nuclei/ffuf) are not bundled in this tier.

star.name: Star
star.description: All guest features in one image: AI Tools, Dev IDE and seven templates, Grafana k6 with k6obs, and the self-contained Vaptr scanner.
